gloss: extending a stay by extra nights

definitions.gloss: to extend one's stay; to stay extra nights
definitions.explanation: To add nights to a booking already made, staying on past the original checkout date. Standard vocabulary at hotel front desks and on booking sites, whether the reason is a delayed flight or simply wanting more time.

examples.japanese: {一泊|いっぱく}{延泊|えんぱく}したいのですが。
examples.english: I'd like to extend my stay by one night.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}で{飛行機|ひこうき}が{欠航|けっこう}になり、{延泊|えんぱく}することになった。
examples.english: The typhoon caused my flight to be cancelled, so I ended up extending my stay.

examples.japanese: {延泊|えんぱく}の{場合|ばあい}、{料金|りょうきん}が{変|か}わることがございます。
examples.english: In the case of an extended stay, the rate may differ.

examples.japanese: {満室|まんしつ}のため{延泊|えんぱく}をお{断|ことわ}りする{場合|ばあい}もありますので、お{早|はや}めにフロントへご{相談|そうだん}ください。
examples.english: We may have to decline an extension if we are fully booked, so please speak to the front desk as early as you can.

notes:
{延|えん} (extend) + {泊|はく} (night's lodging). The number of added nights goes before the word: {一泊|いっぱく}{延泊|えんぱく}する.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {延泊|えんぱく}する: to extend one's stay
- {延泊|えんぱく}を{希望|きぼう}する: to request an extension
- {延泊料金|えんぱくりょうきん}: the rate for extra nights
- {延泊|えんぱく}が{可能|かのう}: extension is possible

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {連泊|れんぱく}: consecutive nights — several nights booked as one stay from the outset, not added later
- {宿泊|しゅくはく}: lodging; staying overnight — the general term
